model_output.verdict: Your product design work at Loop Fitness gives you a clear direction, but your last dated design role ended before your current coffee job. I’d pass for now: the projects are named, but I can’t tell enough about what changed.
write_up: It’s common for a design resume to name the projects but leave out what happened around them. Yours moves from agency work at Brightpath Studio to product design at Loop Fitness, then to Ferry Street Coffee. I read it for Product Designer roles, but the design projects need more detail to stand out in a pile.

The line about creating the app’s first design system in Figma is your best model: it names what you made and the tool you used. Your current role accounts for your time, though a recruiter will notice that Loop Fitness is your last dated design job.
